prompt: The scene of a hasty escape from a 1920s speakeasy backroom. An overturned poker table lies in the center of the room, with playing cards and poker chips scattered across the floor. A spilled whiskey bottle is next to a broken glass. A fedora hat has been left on the floor. In a corner, an open trumpet case reveals its instrument. A tommy gun is propped against the wall. A single lit cigar smolders in an ashtray on a small side table. The room is dimly lit by a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling. A vintage telephone is off its hook. The place was cleared out in a hurry, so there are no people, neither patrons nor police officers. The clandestine nature of the place means there are no large, obvious signs like a neon 'bar' sign, and it's an old establishment, so modern items like a credit card or a digital watch are nowhere to be found.
